source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingAttachmentAccessorsEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.EmailAttachment attachment = new Messaging.EmailAttachment(); attachment.body = Blob.valueOf('trail'); attachment.contentId = 'cid-trail'; attachment.contentType = 'text/plain'; attachment.fileName = 'trail.txt'; System.assertEquals('trail', attachment.body.toString()); System.assertEquals('cid-trail', attachment.contentId); System.assertEquals('text/plain', attachment.contentType); System.assertEquals('trail.txt', attachment.fileName); System.assertEquals(true, attachment.equals(attachment)); System.assertEquals(false, attachment.equals(new Messaging.EmailAttachment())); System.assertEquals(false, attachment.equals(null)); System.assertEquals(attachment.hashCode(), attachment.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, attachment.toString()); attachment.setBody(Blob.valueOf('trail-setter')); attachment.setContentId('cid-setter'); attachment.setContentType('text/setter'); attachment.setFileName('setter.txt'); System.assertEquals('trail-setter', attachment.getBody().toString()); System.assertEquals('cid-setter', attachment.getContentId()); System.assertEquals('text/setter', attachment.getContentType()); System.assertEquals('setter.txt', attachment.getFileName()); Messaging.EmailFileAttachment fileAttachment = new Messaging.EmailFileAttachment(); fileAttachment.body = Blob.valueOf('file'); fileAttachment.contentType = 'application/octet-stream'; fileAttachment.fileName = 'file.bin'; fileAttachment.inline = true; System.assertEquals('file', fileAttachment.body.toString()); System.assertEquals('application/octet-stream', fileAttachment.contentType); System.assertEquals('file.bin', fileAttachment.fileName); System.assertEquals(true, fileAttachment.inline); System.assertEquals(true, fileAttachment.equals(fileAttachment)); System.assertEquals(false, fileAttachment.equals(new Messaging.EmailFileAttachment())); System.assertEquals(false, fileAttachment.equals(null)); System.assertEquals(fileAttachment.hashCode(), fileAttachment.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, fileAttachment.toString()); fileAttachment.setBody(Blob.valueOf('file-setter')); fileAttachment.setContentType('application/setter'); fileAttachment.setFileName('setter.bin'); fileAttachment.setInline(false); System.assertEquals('file-setter', fileAttachment.getBody().toString()); System.assertEquals('application/setter', fileAttachment.getContentType()); System.assertEquals('setter.bin', fileAttachment.getFileName()); System.assertEquals(null, fileAttachment.getId()); System.assertEquals(false, fileAttachment.getInline()); } }
